newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua soybean vessel may head for U.S.. [corrected 20:50 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua soybean vessel may head for U.S.. [corrected 20:50 gmt]

text.p: Cargill Inc is expecting a vessel to arrive at Paranagua port within the next 48 hours to load 50,000 tonnes soybeans and the cargo may be headed for the United States, a spokeswoman for the port said.
Cargill is listed as the agency for the Histria Star, which is flying a Rumanian flag and has no record of origin or destination, she said.

Cargill earlier confirmed it was importing an unspecified amount of soybeans to process in its southeastern U.S. crushing plants. (Corrects from "...confirmed it had sold an unspecified amount of soybeans to a U.S. buyer.")
The beans were due to be shipped between June 15 and July, a spokesman for Cargill in Brazil said.
Any vessel arriving at Paranagua, the largest port in Latin America, usually faces a wait of several days before it can load its cargo.
